purpose: Test whether the different suffix-aware owner decision avoids extra cumulative estimated route cost relative to immediate local reassignment.
primary_success_criterion: All pairs start from the same failure state and pass all strict contract checks; Simple-local selects U2 for B2; CDS-MR selects U3; CDS-MR cumulative estimated suffix route cost is at least 50% lower in the route case and its mirror.
secondary_success_criterion: The branch case satisfies the same decision and route-cost separation.
anti_claims: not evidence of deadline or budget avoidance
not evidence of lower NPSD in general
not evidence of globally optimal routing
